summary:
Strategic HR professional with 17+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition & Management, HR Operations, and People
Strategy across high-growth and transformation-driven environments. Adept at leading end-to-end HR Operation and TA functions
across corporate setups, business expansion and scale-up initiatives, M&A transitions, startup ecosystems, and greenfield
projects, with a proven track record of aligning talent strategy and HR initiatives to organizational business goals.
Extensive experience in leading end-to-end Talent Acquisition and HR Operations for mid-sized global MNCs and large-scale Pan-
India enterprises, spanning diverse sectors including Telecommunications, IT, Chemicals & Fertilizers, Healthcare & Medical
Devices, and Luxury Consumer Durable.
A trusted advisor to CXOs, business heads, and cross-functional teams at corporate and regional levels. Recognized for delivering
impactful outcomes- whether building HR from the ground up, driving enterprise-wide initiatives, managing M&A transitions, or
operating as a strategic individual contributor. My leadership style is grounded in clarity, collaboration, and accountability,
earning consistent trust and credibility among stakeholders.

jobs.company: Watergen India Pvt. Ltd. (New Delhi -India office
bullets: Watergen India Pvt. Ltd. (New Delhi -India office) An Israel-based MNC specializing in Atmospheric Water Generator (AWG) technology, operating in India through a joint venture between Watergen Ltd. and SMV Jaipuria Group. The company is redefining sustainable drinking water access through cutting-edge AWG technology catering to household, commercial, and industrial segments across B2B, B2D, and HNI clients. Its India operations are currently at a startup stage, laying the foundation for growth in this emerging sector.
Collaborated with the Promoter, CEO and Function Heads to design the organizational structure and finalize manpower plans aligned with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
Established the Talent Acquisition function from scratch, designing hiring workflows, SOPs, job descriptions, and interview evaluation frameworks suited to a high-growth environment.
Successfully closed critical leadership roles (CMO, Sales Head- B2B/B2D, Service Head, Production Head) within SLA.
Developed AOP-driven manpower budgeting and workforce forecasting model post-leadership hiring, working closely with functional heads to build costed hiring plans in sync with capacity expansion.

Recruited, mentored and led a high-performing HR team, fostering strong cross-functional partnerships with business and function heads to ensure HR strategies were aligned with organizational goals, enabling scalable growth and enhancing stakeholder satisfaction.

Executed a multi-channel sourcing strategy using platforms like LinkedIn, Naukri, iimjobs along with referrals, campus hiring, mass drives, consultants, and ATS tools, ensuring a steady talent pipeline across business-critical roles.
Achieved time-to-hire reduction from 60 to 30 days through structured hiring pipelines, and interview panel enablement.
Hired and built a high-volume Sales & Service team for a luxury water-tech product, catering to both B2B clients and HNI customers.
Headed the Recruitment of a greenfield manufacturing plant for managing both white-collar and blue-collar workforce.

Recruited the Production Head / Supply Chain Head /Plant HR Officer as the first critical hire to initiate plant setup and operational planning. Drove cross-functional alignment of HR, Production, Admin, Supply Chain & logistic teams during the early project planning phase. 1

Collaborated with Production Head to create an initial phased manpower blueprint aligned with the production timelines and hiring of critical workforce roles including white & blue-collar staff based on production scale-up plans.
Scaled the workforce from ground level to PAN-India presence, building high-performing teams across corporate functions, field sales, service, and manufacturing, aligned with phased growth targets.

Designed and implemented a flexible compensation framework through salary benchmarking for mid and senior-level employees, optimizing the balance between fixed, variable, and performance-linked pay components
Structure the offer letter, appointment letter, salary structure, NDAs, and exit documentation.
Ensured compliance with statutory deductions and registrations as per Indian Labour Laws including Shops & Establishment Act, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), and Labour Welfare Fund (LWF).
Built core HR processes in a fast-paced set-up by developing HR policies & internal guideline as per Indian laws (Leave, Attendance, Maternity Benefit act, Travel, POSH, code of conduct policy etc).
Implemented Keka HRMS to digitize employee lifecycle processes and improve operational efficiency.
Developed and rolled out a structured Induction and Product Training program to support new hires and ongoing development.
Implemented an OKR-based Performance Management System using Keka’s PMS module, aligning individual and team goals with business KPIs through a structured quarterly review cycle.

Developed and rolled out a Manager Toolkit comprising goal-setting templates, performance review forms, and 1-on-1 conversation guides to ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability in performance conversations.

Spearheaded employee engagement through impactful initiatives such as weekly HR Connects, festive celebrations, potlucks, Family Day events, and Wellness programs nurturing a vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative startup culture.
Introduced a Rewards & Recognition (R&R) program to drive appreciation across levels and improve employee morale.

Simplified Sales & Service Team Travel arrangement and collaborated with MakeMyTrip to set up a centralized Travel Desk, reducing manual coordination and enhancing travel efficiency for Sales & Service teams across India.
Developed and documented HR SOPs.

Talent Acquisition & Management Responsible for employee end to end life cycle from hiring to exit. Led post-training evaluation to ensure continuous improvement in knowledge transfer and performance uplift.

Succession Planning & Talent Management Drove identification and development of high-potential talent via Talent Acceleration Program (TAP), with structured IDPs and career conversations. Prepare them for future leadership roles or critical business positions. Conducted stay interviews and readiness assessments for critical roles to strengthen leadership pipeline and minimize attrition risk.
Employee Engagement & Culture Building Curated and delivered a strategic engagement calendar featuring rewards & recognition programs, festive events, and a structured grievance redressal mechanism.

Streamlined Induction & Onboarding processes. Ensured seamless documentation and new joiner handholding. Draft HR policies including Leave, Travel, R&R, Long service, study assistance, child education etc.
Implemented Darwinbox HRMS for HR process automation. 2

Leveraged Darwinbox HRMS across all key modules—including Core HR, Attendance & Leave, Payroll & Compliance, Performance Management (OKRs), Recruitment (ATS), Learning & Development (LMS), Employee Engagement (R&R, surveys), Helpdesk, Expense Management, and HR Analytics—to drive end-to-end HR digitization and enhance process efficiency, compliance, and employee experience.”

Organizational Development (OD) & Change Management Launched structured learning journeys via Unicorn Academy, supporting continuous improvement and upskilling across roles. Building competency frameworks for Sales & Service and designed Unicorn Academy to support a role-based learning journey. Over time, linked each training path to core competencies like product expertise, selling skills, or coaching ability which helped in assess skill gaps and feed into performance evaluations. Embedded OKRs to align team goals with business outcomes.
